gate: new untouched public station-to-vehicle full-loop fueling validation
scope: Targeted recheck of official H2FillS, SAE J2601, DOE/NREL, NLR fueling-experiment publications and public HRS availability sources. Latest recheck added official Cal State LA, NLR HITRF and H2-Stations API sources; no source met the raw full-loop admission contract.

screened_sources.claim_limit: The product page describes a thermodynamic simulation tool and its output fields; it is not a rights-cleared independent logger archive.
The public description specifies protocol limits and scope; it does not provide a synchronized experimental trace.
The resource describes station inventory and availability data, not synchronized pressure-temperature-mass-flow fueling events.
The API exposes station availability and static metadata, not a common-time-base fueling logger.

The article reports real fueling experiments and boundary conditions, but its data-availability statement says research data are not shared; no rights-cleared synchronized raw logger cohort is available from the cited publication.

screened_sources.reported_scope: one-year Cal State LA HRFF fueling-event and station-response study with storage pressure, cooling response, thermodynamics and vehicle SOC context
screened_sources.raw_data_status: no reproducible synchronized raw logger export identified in the public search
screened_sources.claim_limit: The article is credible real-station provenance, but the public record does not expose the channel dictionary, calibration metadata and reuse-cleared common-clock rows required by the frozen full-loop protocol.

usable_for: aggregate throughput and energy sanity checks
screened_sources.reported_scope: approximately 4,500 refueling events and 8,800 kg dispensed over 2016-2020, with electrolyzer, storage, compressor and dispensing domains
screened_sources.raw_data_status: public aggregate study; synchronized raw rows not identified
screened_sources.claim_limit: Aggregate operating counts and energy ranges cannot score the locked transient model or establish full-loop accuracy.

usable_for: SAE J2601 and MC protocol context

screened_sources.raw_data_status: no downloadable synchronized fueling trace identified

screened_sources.claim_limit: Operational status/layout feeds cannot validate thermodynamic behavior or vehicle boundary response.

claim_boundary: This is a source-classification recheck only. It does not establish validation, safety distances, or journal readiness.
